phase_class: fresh cross-law engineering validation; not a novel-physics or unrestricted discovery stage
hypothesis: The fixed Phase-10 18-bit tail-aware causal innovation coordinate system is sufficiently robust for short-context system identification across two qualitatively different synthetic PDE families and their preregistered distribution shifts, without changing the compander, bit budget, context length, feature basis, ridge, or supplying law/parameter labels.

frozen_representation.frame0_anchor: 2048-way coarse + 128-way residual absolute-state RVQ fitted on the fresh joint in-range wave+Gray-Scott training mixture
frozen_representation.innovation_statistics: fresh joint in-range training-mixture one-step innovation mean mu and standard deviation sigma
frozen_representation.quantizer: 512 uniform levels including endpoints independently per channel
frozen_representation.packing: idx0*512+idx1, exactly one 18-bit integer token per cell per saved frame

paired_controls.state_rvq: fresh 2048+128 absolute-state RVQ at the same nominal 18-bit transmitted rate
paired_controls.plain_innovation_rvq: fresh 2048+128 learned innovation RVQ at the same nominal 18-bit transmitted rate
paired_controls.role: reported paired controls only; they cannot rescue a failed companded cross-law gate

frozen_identifier.features: unchanged 16-dimensional Phase-7/10 basis: constant; per channel center, D4 axial radius-1 sum, diagonal radius-1 sum, axial radius-2 sum; center monomials u^2, uv, v^2, u^3, u^2v, uv^2, v^3
frozen_identifier.feature_scaling: per-sequence RMS from the two observed decoded context transitions; constant scale 1

metric: recursive projected rollout MSE / raw-state persistence MSE from final raw context frame
seed_collision_policy: The selected 611370xxx namespace does not overlap any consumed Phase-0 through Phase-10 seeds known in this experiment lineage. Repository code-search was unavailable upstream during preregistration. If a collision with another consumed repository experiment is discovered before Phase-11 execution, Phase 11 must stop and be separately re-preregistered with a new namespace; no registered Phase-11 seed may be silently replaced after consumption.

all_required: for every one of the 3 fresh replicates, companded ratio < 1.0 versus raw persistence on all seven preregistered evaluations
no registered replicate is retried or replaced

report: paired state-RVQ and plain-innovation ratios on every split
whether companded beats both paired controls on wave_combined_ood and gray_combined_ood in each replicate
context reconstruction MSE, context-delta MSE, target-oracle ratio, raw-context projection control, and companded clip fractions

execution_rule: Run each registered replicate exactly once in an independent process and persist its complete result before starting the next. No retry, replacement seed, compander-range change, quantizer-level change, feature change, ridge change, horizon change, or threshold change after a registered attempt is consumed.
implementation_validation_before_seed_co: reuse the exact Phase-10 compander constants and packing semantics
verify Gray-Scott smooth/sharp generators and all requested parameter ranges
verify the same raw trajectory object is supplied to all paired arms without mutation
only non-listed smoke seeds may be used before registered execution
claim_limit: A CROSSLAW_PASS would support only that this frozen discrete coordinate system and supplied local feature prior support context-only prediction across these two known synthetic PDE families and specified shifts. It is not novel physics, unrestricted law discovery, a universal scientific tokenizer, AGI, or SSI.
